newsitem.title: SPAIN: SWIMMING-OFFICIALS WANT MEETING WITH SMITH'S COACH.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-OFFICIALS WANT MEETING WITH SMITH'S COACH.

text.p: European swimming officials want an explanation from the coach and husband of Ireland's triple Olympic champion Michelle Smith before allowing him into the European championships.

Harm Beyer, honorary secretary of the European Swimming League (LEN), said Erik de Bruin had used a false accreditation at the 1995 European championships in Vienna. The German said he wanted to clarify the matter.
"This has to be clarified before we issue an accreditation for one of our events," Beyer said.
He said an accreditation document with De Bruin's picture and the personal details of a Belgian team coach had been detected at a doping control at that meeting.
Beyer said the Irish federation had informed him the team would arrive in Seville on Saturday.he team manager would arrange a date for a meeting involving De Bruin, LEN and the Irish federation.
The swimming programme begins next Tuesday. Smith has entered six events and will compete under her married name for the first time at an international championships.
